what_happened: a cell inserted text into the research design document using a variable named add, which had been defined many cycles earlier to hold validator source code. The assertion that should have stopped the cell ran before the intended definition, so the stale value was used instead.
effect: the design document received about five thousand characters of Python from the validator, including error-append lines and gate configuration
how_it_was_caught: a membership check for the intended heading returned false three times in a row while the file was being written successfully, which is only consistent with the wrong text being inserted
repair: the file was restored from the committed blob and verified to match its committed digest, then the intended section was inserted and checked for the absence of code fragments
why_it_is_recorded: the working state of a long session is itself a hazard: a name that is still bound from an earlier cycle will be used silently, and no gate covers an uncommitted working file
mitigation_adopted: text blocks intended for a document are now defined immediately before use under a distinct name, and the insert is verified by reading the file back rather than by trusting the write
